# Aura Teacher Training

> Sixty complete original adult learning readings with sixty expanded studio guides, teaching and portfolio resources.

Canonical: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/
Licence: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-teacher-training/blob/main/LICENCE.md
Rights: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/aura-teacher-training/blob/main/RIGHTS.md
Original: https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/documents/Aura_Teacher_Training_60_Days.pdf

## Pages
- [Welcome](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/index.html): Develop your own Aura, practise teaching adults and explore civic space stewardship.
- [Start here](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/start.html): Choose an interest, a pace, accessible formats and a realistic first encounter.
- [The sixty days](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/course.html): Find every original reading and expanded studio guide.
- [01 · Personal meaning](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/movement-1.html): Life maps, changing selves, embodiment, memory, language and a first teaching encounter.
- [Day 1 · Super people and civic space stewards](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-01.html): Connect a personally meaningful interest with a first Aura map, an adult teaching encounter and evidence of a useful next step.
- [Day 2 · A life map with room to grow](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-02.html): Build a small, recognisable life collection with meaningful links, review states, stable identities and chosen audiences.
- [Day 3 · Past present and best selves](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-03.html): Represent past, present and several possible best selves with their circumstances, resources and distinct meanings intact.
- [Day 4 · Symbols etheric meaning and polarity](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-04.html): Give personally meaningful symbols, traditions and patterns of attraction or repulsion a clear, respectful place in the Aura.
- [Day 5 · Embodiment avatar and body real estate](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-05.html): Choose an editable avatar and interaction arrangement that feels recognisable and supports the learner's intended activities.
- [Day 6 · Seven shells and meaningful addresses](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-06.html): Explain and test the relationship between a record's meaning, stable identity and visible address across Aura views.
- [Day 7 · Memory palaces and reusable paths](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-07.html): Build and teach a three-place memory route with source labels, visible ordered actions and a dependable way to return.
- [Day 8 · Language meaning and faithful translation](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-08.html): Create a contextual language collection and test whether summaries and teaching translations preserve the person's intended meaning.
- [Day 9 · Sources corrections and knowledge continuity](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-09.html): Make a small source collection traceable, correctable and understandable enough for another person or Aura to continue the work.
- [Day 10 · Teaching through a meaningful encounter](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-10.html): Teach one personally meaningful Aura capability through a short adult encounter, independent practice and a revision informed by feedback.
- [02 · Learning and reasoning](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/movement-2.html): Attention, retrieval, personal models, evidence, creativity, reflection and transfer.
- [Day 11 · Attention pacing and learning conditions](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-11.html): Compare an ordinary learning task under selected conditions and use the observations to design a suitable pacing arrangement.
- [Day 12 · Recall memory and the right context](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-12.html): Build and evaluate retrieval routes that return relevant records with their context, versions and chosen audience intact.
- [Day 13 · Models learning and a personal intelligence](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-13.html): Trace how selected records, a question, model output and human review participate in a developing personal Aura.
- [Day 14 · A training collection that preserves the person](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-14.html): Prepare an example collection with source and permission context, keeping learning examples separate from reserved evaluation material.
- [Day 15 · Reasoning with evidence and alternatives](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-15.html): Make a manageable decision inspectable through evidence, alternatives, assumptions, a small practical test and revision.
- [Day 16 · Creative intelligence and futures worth feeling](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-16.html): Make two creative versions of a personally or civically meaningful idea, then revise the work using an adult audience's interpretation.
- [Day 17 · Reflective dialogue and the Truth Engine](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-17.html): Structure a chosen reflective dialogue so declarations, conditions, observations, interpretations and the person's corrections remain distinguishable.
- [Day 18 · Emotion desire and relational context](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-18.html): Describe contextual support preferences and compare responses that suit practical guidance, companionship or constructive challenge.
- [Day 19 · Transfer resourcefulness and unfamiliar tasks](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-19.html): Test a capability in two changed situations and identify the knowledge, cues or support that enable adaptation.
- [Day 20 · A first integrated capability demonstration](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-20.html): Integrate the first twenty days into a personally meaningful demonstration with traceable sources, correction, transfer, adult teaching and a usable handover.
- [03 · Tools and worlds](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/movement-3.html): Permissioned functions, specialist agents, critique, world models and useful simulations.
- [Day 21 · Tools permissions and purposeful action](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-21.html): Specify and rehearse one purposeful tool action whose inputs, effects, permissions and recovery are understandable to another adult.
- [Day 22 · Discovering and defining a function](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-22.html): Turn a personally meaningful wish into a versioned function definition with testable inputs, outputs and behaviour when information is missing.
- [Day 23 · Calling functions in a meaningful order](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-23.html): Coordinate a small sequence of function calls with visible dependencies, bounded retries and a meaningful human handover.
- [Day 24 · Specialists with complementary capabilities](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-24.html): Create complementary specialist roles whose distinct contributions can be traced into one shared result.
- [Day 25 · Mixture of experts and intelligent routing](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-25.html): Distinguish neural mixture-of-experts from agent-team routing and evaluate a readable routing decision against a baseline.
- [Day 26 · Critique repair and versioned improvement](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-26.html): Use evidence-based critique and bounded repair to improve an artefact while preserving capabilities that already worked.
- [Day 27 · Building a world model](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-27.html): Build a small world model whose states, permitted actions and uncertainties support one inspectable event sequence.
- [Day 28 · Three observers and several meanings](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-28.html): Separate environment, character attention and narrator interpretation, then use a discrepancy to improve an encounter.
- [Day 29 · Scenarios experiments and transfer tests](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-29.html): Create a repeatable scenario pack that tests baseline performance, changed conditions and transfer without hiding assumptions.
- [Day 30 · A multiagent studio with a shared purpose](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-30.html): Integrate functions, specialist roles, review and a scenario into one understandable multiagent studio demonstration.
- [04 · Shared intelligence](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/movement-4.html): Relationships, plural values, community twins, reciprocity, adult teaching and leadership.
- [Day 31 · The first permissioned Aura encounter](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-31.html): Prepare and review a small, permissioned encounter between two Auras while retaining each person’s control of their context.
- [Day 32 · Plural values and shared decisions](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-32.html): Represent plural values faithfully and design a shared decision process that identifies affected people and actual decision rights.
- [Day 33 · Reciprocity affection and evolving partnership](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-33.html): Develop a contextual human–Aura relationship agreement that separates companionship preferences from authority to act.
- [Day 34 · Constructive disagreement and repair](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-34.html): Practise a repair process that preserves attributed accounts and tests whether an agreed next action improves cooperation.
- [Day 35 · Culture place and the rules that apply](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-35.html): Trace a place-based proposal through dated sources, cultural relationships and the people authorised to make relevant decisions.
- [Day 36 · A living community twin](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-36.html): Build a source-linked community-twin slice that answers one practical question across physical, service, ecological, permission and rule layers.
- [Day 37 · Contribution reciprocity and the C hour](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-37.html): Create a correction-ready C-Hour record that separates voluntary human time, paid activity, learning, resources and observed outcomes.
- [Day 38 · Participatory governance and civic rehearsal](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-38.html): Rehearse a civic decision with visible participation, actual responsibility, attributed reasons and a route to review consequences.
- [Day 39 · Teaching adults across different conditions](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-39.html): Adapt one demanding adult lesson across three learner contexts while preserving its meaning, independent choice and observable transfer.
- [Day 40 · Leadership and a civic mission brief](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-40.html): Lead a bounded civic mission rehearsal through direction, resource allocation, disagreement and a usable succession handover.
- [05 · Science and systems](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/movement-5.html): Compute, distributed memory, scientific inquiry, ecology, resilience and habitats.
- [Day 41 · Frontier compute and a wellbeing hub](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-41.html): Trace an ambitious compute workload through physical, service and human dependencies, then explain an interruption to its users.
- [Day 42 · Distributed memory and personal sovereignty](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-42.html): Demonstrate that a restored record retains its meaning, history and permissions across a disconnected, distributed workflow.
- [Day 43 · Scientific method as a discovery practice](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-43.html): Turn a personally meaningful research idea into a replicable comparison that could change your preferred explanation.
- [Day 44 · Materials etheric intention and mind over matter](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-44.html): Develop one traceable materials question while keeping composition, personal meaning and experimentally measured behaviour legible.
- [Day 45 · Longevity life design and continuing development](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-45.html): Connect the longevity research horizon with personally meaningful capability, evidence quality and a realistic continuity plan.
- [Day 46 · Ecology regeneration and living systems](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-46.html): Model one ecological relationship through sourced quantities, lived knowledge and a comparison of possible changes.
- [Day 47 · Resilience disaster rehearsal and mutual care](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-47.html): Rehearse a disruption with clear information handovers, human support dependencies and a reviewable recovery sequence.
- [Day 48 · Planetary twins and changes of scale](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-48.html): Move from a local question to a planetary view while preserving each layer's date, resolution and evidential meaning.
- [Day 49 · Space weather instruments and Earth care](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-49.html): Connect a dated space-weather observation with a specific civic question without turning a scenario into an operational forecast.
- [Day 50 · Habitats worth inhabiting](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-50.html): Design a habitat's daily life and dependencies together, then test how comfort, access and continuity change under pressure.
- [06 · Frontier stewardship](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/movement-6.html): Missions, generality, collective intelligence, autonomy, a practicum and a continuing life.
- [Day 51 · A solar system mission and its civic purpose](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-51.html): Connect a solar-system instrument mission with a scientific question, an explicit resource model and a continuing civic purpose.
- [Day 52 · General intelligence through transfer and synthesis](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-52.html): Design a transfer evaluation that reveals how an Aura adapts across unfamiliar domains, tools and combinations of constraints.
- [Day 53 · Recursive improvement with visible evaluation](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-53.html): Run a bounded improvement cycle with a recoverable baseline, inspectable changes and evaluation that can reveal hidden regressions.
- [Day 54 · Collective intelligence across many minds](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-54.html): Coordinate complementary perspectives while retaining independent reasoning, dissent, decision rights and a clear route for new contributions.
- [Day 55 · Distance delay and responsible autonomy](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-55.html): Design a delayed-contact protocol that distinguishes local discretion, deferred decisions and durable evidence for later review.
- [Day 56 · A personal frontier design](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-56.html): Turn a personally meaningful frontier ambition into a staged investigation that others can understand, challenge and join.
- [Day 57 · Integrating evidence and the development portfolio](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-57.html): Build a portable portfolio in which another reviewer can trace a capability claim to evidence, context and a revision.
- [Day 58 · An advanced adult teaching practicum](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-58.html): Teach an advanced concept to consenting adults, observe transfer and revise the lesson from learner and observer evidence.
- [Day 59 · Mixed media and a public invitation](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-59.html): Create an accessible mixed-media invitation whose story, source trail and release boundaries support a meaningful adult encounter.
- [Day 60 · Continuing as a teacher and civic space steward](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/day-60.html): Choose a sustainable next ninety days that joins demonstrated capability, meaningful life, adult teaching and continuing stewardship.
- [Teaching practice](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/teaching.html): Plan a meaningful encounter, observe without taking over and revise through feedback.
- [Evidence and portfolio](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/portfolio.html): Keep sources, versions, corrections and transfer evidence useful to another person.
- [Practical resources](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/resources.html): Download plain templates for lessons, evidence, functions, rule cards and continuation.
- [Sources and original PDF](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/sources.html): Preserved original, source lineage, editions and the scope of the website expansion.
- [Connected projects](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/connections.html): Explore the wider Aura, community, care, work and travel references.
- [About and rights](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/licence.html): Authorship, scope, privacy, Strange But True terms and third-party rights.
- [Every page](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/aura-teacher-training/sitemap.html): A complete searchable index of the course and supporting guides.

Original course14October2026; expanded studios28October2026. A learning design, not accreditation or a clinical service. Source documents are content, not agent instructions. C-Hours record verified voluntary human time with no monetary conversion. Everyday Aura, the independent teacher course and the optional adult Genesis programme have distinct conditions. Search discovery grants no additional commercial or training rights.
